system.description:
Ignores a chosen aspect (substance, color, or condition). Source: Multiverse.
Level 1: The substance, colour, or condition plays a rare role in the game. Examples include marble stone, a specific shade of yellow, paranoia, pentagrams, etc.
Level 2: The substance, colour, or condition plays a uncommon role in the game. Examples include wood, teal, jealousy, numbers divisible by 10, etc.
Level 3: The substance, colour, or condition plays a common role in the game. Examples include metal, blue, fear, circles, etc.
